comment: Phenomenological VT-shift rules. Seeded from APFEA v3 (Part One, I): 'Example for Fabric or SOC chip with foundry plain test chip PDK: RVTsN/P: RVT0+2%; LVTsN/P: LVT0-6%; ULVTsN/P: ULVT0-4%; x% based on process & experience.' Percentages act on |VT| (device strength); the sign of VT0 is preserved. These are CONFIG, not physical law - a foundry/design-house pair replaces them with values fitted from their own test-chip vs customer-chip history.
est_err_note: Residual VT-shift estimation error (%) carried into the APFEA-flow margin check. Set from historical estimator accuracy; 0.5% is a placeholder.
